scope: Scoped verified swap reads for original-source HDR LOD on Metal
implementation: One open file and one managed 64KiB verified block per LOD calculation
Reuse managed source row across output-row boundaries
Failed block replacement invalidates cached verification before I/O; partial output is never published by LOD worker

warm_filesystem_row_benchmark.limits: Warm filesystem, local synthetic read comparison; not full viewer latency or physical slow-disk qualification

remaining: Physical HDR display calibration and luminance unverified
